description: The workbook records water-quality measurements at 21 Brampton stormwater ponds sampled in May and July 2022. This resource is provided by Gab Izma. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists XLSX formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Two sampling rounds do not describe annual variability. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epa-swmm. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
name: Stormwater pond water monitoring results
